:::{#def-nested-cv}
#### Nested cross-validation

**Nested cross-validation** is [$\nfolds$-fold cross-validation](#def-kfold)
of the [cross-validation choice procedure](#def-cv-choice) $\candproctuned{\text{CV}}$:
its estimate on a training set $\trainset$ is

$$
\cvestoff{\nfolds}{\candproctuned{\text{CV}}}{\trainset}.
$$ {#eq-nested-cv}

:::

:::{#rem-source-nested-cv}
#### Source: Nested cross-validation

@hastie2009elements [sec. 7.10.2] for cross-validating every step of a procedure,
choices included.

:::
